# Pong Home

> Pong Home is a global table tennis platform: on-demand coaching in Canada and the United States, the Pong Home Store for table tennis gear shipped across the US and Canada, with VICTAS products at the best price, the Gear Index, a rubber and blade ratings database where players find and rate equipment, and the Discount Center, a directory of table tennis store promo codes.

Pong Home is built around four connected products: coaching, the Store, the Gear Index, and the Discount Center. All four point back to the same goal: helping table tennis players in Toronto (and beyond) find the right coach, the right gear, and the right community.

## Coaching (Toronto, ON, Canada focus)

Pong Home connects players with advanced and national-level coaches for one-on-one and small-group table tennis coaching, from beginners through competitive athletes. Coaching is offered in Toronto and New York City, with matchmaking between players and coaches and a local community around the sport. This is the primary product for anyone searching for "table tennis coaching Toronto," "ping pong lessons Toronto," or a private table tennis coach.

- [Home / Book Coaching](https://ponghome.com/): Browse coaches, book on-demand table tennis lessons in Toronto, get matched by skill level.

## Store: table tennis gear shipped across the US and Canada

The Pong Home Store is the online store for table tennis rubbers, blades, tables, and accessories, with shipping across the United States and Canada. It carries VICTAS products at the best price and is sponsored by VICTAS. Every product shows its price and a clear In stock or Sold out status, Best seller products are placed at the top, and each product has an **Order now** button to start an order. This is the place to go for players searching for VICTAS rubbers, blades, and table tennis gear online in the US or Canada.

- [Store](https://ponghome.com/store): Shop VICTAS products and other table tennis gear at the best price, shipped across the US and Canada. Order now.

## Gear Index (Ratings)

The Gear Index is a searchable, filterable database covering thousands of table tennis rubbers and blades, with speed, spin, control, and stiffness ratings for each. Players use it to compare equipment and choose the right setup for their playing style before buying, including filtering by rubber type (inverted, long pips, short pips, medium pips) and sorting by brand. Beyond browsing official ratings, players can also **add their own personal rating** for any rubber or blade (on a 1–10 scale across attributes like speed, spin/control, and stiffness), saved to their own device, making it a community-informed resource as well as a reference database.

- [Gear Index](https://ponghome.com/ratings): Search and compare table tennis rubber and blade ratings; rate equipment yourself.

## Discount Center

The Discount Center is a directory of promo codes and discount offers from table tennis stores worldwide, organized by region and store. Each offer is graded by trustworthiness: Valid means a specific, checkable policy (an exact percentage, a named page, a stated threshold); Unverified means the source was vague or unconfirmed; Expired means a code no longer works. Players can filter by region or store name, copy a code directly, and **update the status themselves** based on what they find at checkout, saved to their own device.

- [Discount Center](https://ponghome.com/discount): Browse table tennis store promo codes by region or store, copy a code before you check out.

## Book a Table (Pong Home by the Dill)

- [Booking](https://ponghome.com/booking): Reserve a table at the Pong Home club. Standard rate $19 per table per hour, off-peak rate $15 per table per hour (Mon to Fri, 9 AM to 5 PM).

## Tools

- [Tools](https://ponghome.com/tools): Free Arena tournament bracket generator and on-court digital Scoreboard app.
- [Scoreboard](https://ponghome.com/scoreboard): Free voice-scored digital scoreboard for on-court table tennis matches.
- [Doubles Scoreboard](https://ponghome.com/scoreboard-doubles): Free doubles scoreboard for 4 players and 2 teams with automatic ITTF style serve rotation.
- [Scoreboard Remote for Apple Watch](https://ponghome.com/score-watch): Free tap to score remote for table tennis on Apple Watch, best of 3, 5, or 7.
- [Arena](https://ponghome.com/tournament): Free table tennis tournament bracket generator.
